title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Plan Schedule — Destinations, Entry Levels and Verification
content:
# Schedule A to the Cartwise Shopper Payouts plan terms: where money is sent and who may hold each plan

Cartwise Shopper Payouts is offered on six payout plans. Each plan fixes the kind of destination money is sent to, the lowest shopper level that may hold it, how the destination is verified, and the limits on changing plan or destination. The figures below are the plan's own values; every rule of the payout terms that refers to "the plan's" figure reads it from this schedule.

## A.1 Plan figures

| Plan | Destination money is sent to | Lowest shopper level that may hold the plan | Verification method | Verification window (calendar days after opening) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | Bank account | Shop-Only Shopper | Micro-deposits | 10 |
| Instant Cashout | External debit card | Shop-Only Shopper | Card push test | 7 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | Cartwise card (Everyday Pay Card) | Shop-Only Shopper | Card activation | 30 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | Cartwise card (Everyday Pay Card) | Full-Service Shopper Silver | Card activation | 30 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | Cartwise card (Everyday Pay Card) | Full-Service Shopper Gold | Card activation | 30 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | Cartwise card (Everyday Pay Card) | Full-Service Shopper Diamond | Card activation | 30 |

## A.2 Change limits

| Plan | Plan changes allowed in a rolling 30 days | Card plan moves with the shopper level at each level evaluation | Destination changes allowed in a rolling 30 days | Instant cashouts blocked after a destination change (elapsed hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | 2 | No | 2 | 72 |
| Instant Cashout | 2 | No | 2 | 72 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | 2 | Yes | 1 | 72 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | 2 | Yes | 1 | 48 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | 2 | Yes | 1 | 48 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | 2 | Yes | 1 | 24 |

## A.3 Reading the schedule

- **Lowest shopper level.** The level named is the minimum; a shopper at that level or any higher level on the shopper ladder meets it. The four Everyday Pay Card plans rise in entry level from Blue to Diamond, while Weekly Direct Deposit, Instant Cashout and Everyday Pay Card Blue are open from Shop-Only Shopper.
- **Verification window.** The figure is a count of calendar days after the opening date of the payout account.
- **Card plans that follow the level.** On the four Everyday Pay Card plans the "Yes" means the card plan moves with the shopper's level each time levels are evaluated; on Weekly Direct Deposit and Instant Cashout the plan does not move with the level.
- **Cooldown.** The cooldown is a count of elapsed hours from the moment the destination was changed, not a count of calendar days.

## A.4 Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver level compares plans. Reading the lowest-level column, Weekly Direct Deposit, Instant Cashout, Everyday Pay Card Blue and Everyday Pay Card Gold are all at or below Full-Service Shopper Silver; Everyday Pay Card Platinum (Full-Service Shopper Gold) and Everyday Pay Card Diamond (Full-Service Shopper Diamond) are above it. On Everyday Pay Card Gold that shopper's destination is the Everyday Pay Card, verified by card activation within 30 calendar days of opening, with one destination change allowed in a rolling 30 days and a 48-hour cashout block after it.
